memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared. Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters, and then he died. When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch. Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters, and then he died. - Gen 5:15-20 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Mahalalel and Jared - two more links in a long chain of generations. The list rolls on, and it might seem that nothing new is being said. But there is a beautiful truth hidden in this steady repetition: God is faithfully carrying His purposes forward, generation after generation, even through people whose names we can barely pronounce.

Behind these dry-sounding records lies a living promise. Back in Eden, God had promised that one day a descendant of the woman would crush the serpent's head (Gen 3:15). Every birth in this chapter is a step toward that promise. God was patiently, quietly, faithfully preserving the line through which the Saviour would come.

That tells us something wonderful about how God works. He is not in a hurry. He works across centuries and generations, weaving His plan through ordinary families and everyday births. What looks like a plain list to us was, to God, the unfolding of redemption.

You are part of a story bigger than your own lifetime. The God who was faithful through Mahalalel and Jared is faithful still, and He "who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion" (Phil 1:6). His purposes never stall, never fail, never forget a single generation.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you trust that God is working out His purposes even when nothing seems to be happening?
- How does it help to know you are part of a bigger story?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Faithful God, thank You that You carry Your purposes forward across every generation, never in a hurry and never failing. Help me trust Your patient, faithful hand over my life.
